Photorealistic premium food-comedy commercial, vertical 9:16, energetic editorial rhythm, warm cream and natural kitchen light, realistic faces and anatomically correct hands. The unusual recipe is a transparent bright yellow scalloped ring of savory vegetable gelatin containing celery, green bell pepper and chopped onion, with a central hole; preserve the dish shown in the food reference. No writing, captions, logos, watermarks, app UI, graphic overlays or music: those will be composited later. Natural action sound effects only. Shots must be clear, physical actions, not a slideshow. COMMUNITY CHALLENGE, SEVEN SECONDS. Food images 1 and 2 show the same yellow vegetable gelatin ring to recreate. Cast fictional adults, not celebrities. This sequence contains a clean 3x3 reaction grid and then three distinct kitchen panels; panels have thin neutral borders, no text.
0.0–2.0s: a precise nine-person grid, nine different adults in nine portrait cells, all clearly visible and reacting naturally with shock, laughter or delighted disbelief. Age and appearance variety. Establish these THREE FEATURED COOKS in the middle row: left, a Black adult man with short hair wearing a burgundy T-shirt; center, an East Asian adult woman with a straight dark bob wearing a blue apron; right, an older white adult man with gray hair wearing a mustard-yellow shirt. Other six cells contain different adult friends, no duplicates. The nine faces should look alive and expressive, not still photos.
2.0–5.0s: clean hard cut to THREE VERTICAL PANELS filling the frame. These exact three featured cooks are now actively making the same vegetable gelatin ring in their different home kitchens. Left cook stirs yellow mixture with visible green vegetables, center cook pours the mixture into a scalloped ring mold, right cook unmolds a finished yellow vegetable gelatin ring. Show their faces and hand actions, not only finished food. Different kitchens, different home plates, same recognizable recipe.
5.0–7.0s: maintain three vertical panels. All three now have their own slightly imperfect finished yellow vegetable gelatin rings. Each person lifts or aims a black smartphone at their own dish and photographs it. Distinct white, pale blue and patterned plates make the attempts individual. End with the three homemade results clearly visible. Add a little overlapping laughter, one surprised gasp, and three camera shutter sounds. No readable phone screens, no speech claims, no logos, no numbers or captions. No main cook in these panels. No extra fingers or fused people.
